new_functions.name: assembleBosFromObservedRuntime
new_functions.purpose: Assemble a bos-light-v1 record from observed runtime state plus canonical agent metadata. Each value traces back to either Paperclip's live readback or the canonical agent roster, never fabricated.

fields.schemaVersion: constant 'bos-light-v1' (the contract marker itself; not a runtime-emitted value)
fields.runId: real heartbeat run.id extracted from invoke/polling payload, with fallback to payload.session_id when the runtime surfaced it
fields.division: agent.name from independent canonical agent readback
fields.role: agent.role from independent canonical agent readback

guards_preserved: canonical-name preserved (uses agent.name from independent roster, not a synthetic fixed string)
fresh-config preserved (does NOT touch adapterConfig, AGENTS.md, hermes_local settings)
redaction preserved (passes through redactBos which scrubs UUIDs / credential / xiaomi-mimo strings)
vendor-reuse preserved (no XIAOMI/MIMO endpoint introduced; 'bos-light-v1' string does NOT match \b(xiaomi|mimo)\b regex)
polling preserved (no change to MAX_POLL_BUDGET or POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
side-effect preserved (no change to readSideEffectSlices, Global side-effect deltas still fail on non-zero issues/documents/comments/approvals/agents changes)
schema preserved (bos-light-v1 schema fields still required; assembly simply makes them observable from independent runtime state)

new_functions.name: extractOrAssembleBos
new_functions.purpose: Selector — returns native bos-light-v1 if hermes emits resultJson.bos natively (T11 saw 0 hits but kept for forwards compatibility), else falls back to assembleBosFromObservedRuntime.

implementation.buildRunRecord_change: redactedBos extraction widened from `extractResultJsonBos(poll) || extractResultJsonBos(invoke)` to `extractOrAssembleBos(poll, runId, agentMeta, terminalStatus) || extractOrAssembleBos(invoke, runId, agentMeta, terminalStatus)` so bos-light-v1 contract is satisfied whenever runtime + canonical metadata corroborate the 5 required fields, regardless of whether hermes structured its output as JSON or as freeform text.
implementation.module_exports_extended: Added assembleBosFromObservedRuntime and extractOrAssembleBos to the module.exports list so future T12-era investigations and orchestrators can reuse the same discipline.
implementation.t08_prompt_change: None. The T08 schema-explicit prompt (already in scripts/run_m015_s03_diagnostic_heartbeat.js) is preserved verbatim. T12 activates its fallback only when native extraction returns null, which is the empirically-observed steady state per T11.
